title.it: I desideri: I wish, if only
title.en: I wish I had a dog; if only I'd known

goal.sl: Poveš, kaj si želiš zdaj (I wish I had a dog), kaj bi {m:hotel|f:hotela}, da bi bilo takrat (I wish I'd listened), kaj naj se spremeni (I wish it would stop), in ločiš wish od hope.
goal.de: Du sagst, was du dir jetzt wünschst (I wish I had a dog), was damals anders sein sollte (I wish I'd listened) und was anders werden soll (I wish it would stop), und unterscheidest wish und hope.
goal.it: Dici che cosa vorresti adesso (I wish I had a dog), che cosa avresti voluto allora (I wish I'd listened) e che cosa dovrebbe cambiare (I wish it would stop), e distingui wish e hope.
goal.en: You can say what you wish now (I wish I had a dog), what you wish had happened (I wish I'd listened) and what you want to change (I wish it would stop), and tell wish from hope.

say.sl: **wish** (želeti si) + preteklik pove, kaj zdaj ni tako: **I wish I had a dog.** (Ko bi le {m:imel|f:imela} psa.) **I wish I knew.** (Ko bi le {m:vedel|f:vedela}.) Preteklik tu ne pomeni prej, ampak *ni res*, kot za if.
say.de: **wish** (sich wünschen) + Vergangenheit sagt, was jetzt nicht so ist: **I wish I had a dog.** (Ich wünschte, ich hätte einen Hund.) **I wish I knew.** (Ich wünschte, ich wüsste es.) Die Vergangenheit heißt hier nicht früher, sondern *nicht wirklich*, wie nach if.
say.it: **wish** (desiderare) + il passato dice che cosa adesso non è così: **I wish I had a dog.** (Vorrei avere un cane.) **I wish I knew.** (Magari lo sapessi.) Il passato qui non vuol dire prima, ma *non è vero*, come dopo if.
say.en: **wish** + the past says what isn't so now: **I wish I had a dog.** **I wish I knew.** The past here doesn't mean earlier: it means *not really*, as after if.

examples.en: I wish I had a dog.
examples.de: Ich wünschte, ich hätte einen Hund.

rows: I wish I had a dog.

say.sl: Z **be** je prav oboje: **I wish it was warmer.** **I wish it were warmer.** (Ko bi le bilo topleje.) **were** je bolj uradno. Za to, česar ne znaš ali ne moreš, **could**: **I wish I could swim.** (Ko bi le {m:znal|f:znala} plavati.)
say.de: Bei **be** ist beides richtig: **I wish it was warmer.** **I wish it were warmer.** (Ich wünschte, es wäre wärmer.) **were** ist förmlicher. Für das, was du nicht kannst, **could**: **I wish I could swim.** (Ich wünschte, ich könnte schwimmen.)
say.it: Con **be** sono giusti tutti e due: **I wish it was warmer.** **I wish it were warmer.** (Magari facesse più caldo.) **were** è più formale. Per ciò che non sai o non puoi, **could**: **I wish I could swim.** (Magari sapessi nuotare.)
say.en: With **be**, both are right: **I wish it was warmer.** **I wish it were warmer.** **were** is more formal. For what you can't do, **could**: **I wish I could swim.**

explain.de:

explain.it:

explain.en:

say.sl: **wish** + **had** + deležnik pove, kaj se takrat ni zgodilo: **I wish I'd listened.** (Ko bi {m:poslušal|f:poslušala} takrat.) **I wish I hadn't sold the van.** (Ko le ne bi {m:prodal|f:prodala} kombija.) Tudi **could have**: **I wish I could have come.** Slovenščina reče obakrat *ko bi le*, angleščina loči.
say.de: **wish** + **had** + Partizip sagt, was damals nicht war: **I wish I'd listened.** (Ich wünschte, ich hätte zugehört.) **I wish I hadn't sold the van.** (Ich wünschte, ich hätte den Lieferwagen nicht verkauft.) Auch **could have**: **I wish I could have come.**
say.it: **wish** + **had** + participio dice che cosa allora non è stato: **I wish I'd listened.** (Magari avessi ascoltato.) **I wish I hadn't sold the van.** (Magari non avessi venduto il furgone.) Anche **could have**: **I wish I could have come.**
say.en: **wish** + **had** + the participle says what didn't happen then: **I wish I'd listened.** **I wish I hadn't sold the van.** Also **could have**: **I wish I could have come.**

examples.en: I wish I hadn't sold the van.
examples.de: Ich wünschte, ich hätte den Lieferwagen nicht verkauft.
examples.it: Magari non avessi venduto il furgone.

say.sl: **wish** + **would** pove, kaj bi se moralo spremeniti: **I wish it would stop raining.** (Ko bi le nehalo deževati.) **I wish you wouldn't shout.** (Ko le ne bi {m:kričal|f:kričala}.) Zase rečeš **could**: **I wish I could stop.**
say.de: **wish** + **would** sagt, was anders werden soll: **I wish it would stop raining.** (Ich wünschte, es würde aufhören zu regnen.) **I wish you wouldn't shout.** (Ich wünschte, du würdest nicht schreien.) Für dich selbst **could**: **I wish I could stop.**
say.it: **wish** + **would** dice che cosa dovrebbe cambiare: **I wish it would stop raining.** (Magari smettesse di piovere.) **I wish you wouldn't shout.** (Vorrei che tu non gridassi.) Per te stess{m:o|f:a} **could**: **I wish I could stop.**
say.en: **wish** + **would** says what you want to change: **I wish it would stop raining.** **I wish you wouldn't shout.** For yourself, **could**: **I wish I could stop.**

examples.en: I wish it would stop raining.
examples.de: Ich wünschte, es würde aufhören zu regnen.

say.sl: **if only** je močnejše od wish, časi so isti: **If only I knew!** (Ko bi le {m:vedel|f:vedela}!) **If only I'd known!** (Ko bi le takrat {m:vedel|f:vedela}!) **If only it would stop!** (Ko bi le nehalo!)
say.de: **if only** ist stärker als wish, die Zeiten sind dieselben: **If only I knew!** (Wenn ich es nur wüsste!) **If only I'd known!** (Hätte ich es nur gewusst!) **If only it would stop!** (Wenn es nur aufhören würde!)
say.it: **if only** è più forte di wish, i tempi sono gli stessi: **If only I knew!** (Se solo lo sapessi!) **If only I'd known!** (Se solo l'avessi saputo!) **If only it would stop!** (Se solo smettesse!)
say.en: **if only** is stronger than wish, with the same tenses: **If only I knew!** **If only I'd known!** **If only it would stop!**

explain.sl:
**if only: isti časi kot wish**
- If only I knew the way!
explain.de:
**if only: dieselben Zeiten wie wish**
- If only I knew the way!
explain.it:
**if only: gli stessi tempi di wish**
- If only I knew the way!
explain.en:
**if only: the same tenses as wish**
- If only I knew the way!

say.sl: **hope** je za to, kar se še lahko zgodi, s sedanjikom: **I hope it stops raining.** (Upam, da bo nehalo deževati.) V govoru ljudje rečejo tudi *I wish I'd have known*. Pisno velja **I wish I had known**. *I wish I would have known* je pogost spodrsljaj.
say.de: **hope** ist für das, was noch geschehen kann, mit dem Präsens: **I hope it stops raining.** (Ich hoffe, es hört auf zu regnen.) Gesprochen sagt man auch *I wish I'd have known*. Geschrieben gilt **I wish I had known**. *I wish I would have known* ist ein häufiger Ausrutscher.
say.it: **hope** è per ciò che può ancora succedere, col presente: **I hope it stops raining.** (Spero che smetta di piovere.) A voce si dice anche *I wish I'd have known*. Per iscritto vale **I wish I had known**. *I wish I would have known* è una svista comune.
say.en: **hope** is for what may still happen, with the present: **I hope it stops raining.** In talk people also say *I wish I'd have known*. Writing wants **I wish I had known**. *I wish I would have known* is a common slip.

examples.de: Ich hoffe, es hört auf zu regnen.

exercises.title: Old Wilf and Sam
exercises.text: — I wish I ___ (be) young again, Sam. — So do I, Wilf. And I wish I ___ (not sell) my old van. — If only you ___ (ask) me first! And I wish this rain ___ (stop). — It won't. I wish I ___ (live) somewhere warm. — You'd hate it. I wish you ___ (not complain) all the time. — If only I ___ (can) walk up the fell again. — I hope you ___ (feel) better tomorrow.

translation.sl: — Ko bi le bil spet mlad, Sam. — Tudi jaz, Wilf. In ko le ne bi prodal svojega starega kombija. — Ko bi me le prej vprašal! In ko bi le ta dež nehal. — Ne bo. Ko bi le živel nekje, kjer je toplo. — Ne bi ti bilo všeč. Ko le ne bi ves čas jamral. — Ko bi le spet lahko šel na hrib. — Upam, da se boš jutri bolje počutil.
translation.de: — Ich wünschte, ich wäre wieder jung, Sam. — Ich auch, Wilf. Und ich wünschte, ich hätte meinen alten Lieferwagen nicht verkauft. — Hättest du mich nur vorher gefragt! Und ich wünschte, dieser Regen würde aufhören. — Tut er nicht. Ich wünschte, ich würde irgendwo wohnen, wo es warm ist. — Das würde dir nicht gefallen. Ich wünschte, du würdest nicht dauernd jammern. — Wenn ich nur wieder auf den Berg gehen könnte. — Ich hoffe, es geht dir morgen besser.
translation.it: — Magari fossi di nuovo giovane, Sam. — Anch'io, Wilf. E magari non avessi venduto il mio vecchio furgone. — Se solo me l'avessi chiesto prima! E magari smettesse questa pioggia. — Non smetterà. Magari abitassi in un posto caldo. — Non ti piacerebbe. Vorrei che non ti lamentassi sempre. — Se solo potessi risalire sul monte. — Spero che domani ti senta meglio.
translation.en: — I wish I was young again, Sam. — So do I, Wilf. And I wish I hadn't sold my old van. — If only you had asked me first! And I wish this rain would stop. — It won't. I wish I lived somewhere warm. — You'd hate it. I wish you wouldn't complain all the time. — If only I could walk up the fell again. — I hope you feel better tomorrow.

exercises.title: After the quarrel
exercises.text: I wish I ___ (have) more time. I wish I ___ (not say) that to Edna yesterday. If only she ___ (talk) to me now! I wish it ___ (stop) snowing, so I could go and see her. I hope she ___ (be) at home tomorrow.

translation.sl: Ko bi le {m:imel|f:imela} več časa. Ko le ne bi včeraj tega {m:rekel|f:rekla} Edni. Ko bi le zdaj govorila z mano! Ko bi le nehalo snežiti, da bi lahko {m:šel|f:šla} k njej. Upam, da bo jutri doma.
translation.de: Ich wünschte, ich hätte mehr Zeit. Ich wünschte, ich hätte das gestern nicht zu Edna gesagt. Wenn sie nur jetzt mit mir reden würde! Ich wünschte, es würde aufhören zu schneien, damit ich zu ihr gehen könnte. Ich hoffe, sie ist morgen daheim.
translation.it: Magari avessi più tempo. Magari ieri non avessi detto quella cosa a Edna. Se solo adesso mi parlasse! Magari smettesse di nevicare, così potrei andare da lei. Spero che domani sia a casa.
translation.en: I wish I had more time. I wish I hadn't said that to Edna yesterday. If only she would talk to me now! I wish it would stop snowing, so I could go and see her. I hope she is at home tomorrow.
